title: [review] test_vectors.py: Self-referential fallback in channel ass
description: The assertion `assert ch == o.get("select_channel", o.get("expected_channel", o.get("channel", ch)))` has the computed `ch` as the innermost fallback, causing the test to always pass if none of the expected keys exist in the output dict.
close_reason: Already fixed in commit 4c5c4af6cc8 (2026-08-24). The self-referential fallback pattern was replaced with direct key access. Tests pass.
